extraction.Name: Lucy Larvie Quick Bear
extraction.Refused/Protested: No. I did not ask for the patent but it was given me.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered in 1918 from the Farmer at Norris. Sold land for $5000.00 cash. Did not settle any debts with purchaser at time of sale. Signed a receipt for the patent. Has four children. Supported by herself and husband. States she is not in good health. Affidavit sworn before Chas. W. Cross, Notary Public, June 4, 1929; commission expires 4-28-32. Deponent signed with an X mark.
